# IMPULSES.ART

> Therapeutic music project combining live piano performance with research-informed approaches to wellbeing. Supporting immigrant and refugee communities in the United States.

## About

IMPULSES.ART is a therapeutic music initiative founded and directed by Ernesto Cisneros Cino, an internationally experienced pianist, composer, educator, and visual artist based in Miami, Florida. The project integrates live piano improvisation with methods informed by published research in psychology, neuroscience, and the expressive arts.

The project focuses on immigrant and refugee communities, creating safe spaces for emotional expression, trauma recovery, and cultural integration — while remaining open to anyone seeking therapeutic benefit through music.

## Services

- Group Therapeutic Music Sessions: Collective healing through live piano improvisation and participatory dynamics
- Individual Therapeutic Music Sessions: One-on-one personalized therapeutic work
- Community Workshops: Specialized programs for organizations, schools, churches, and cultural centers
- Virtual Sessions: Remote therapeutic music sessions maintaining full quality and interactivity

## Research Foundation

The approach is grounded in peer-reviewed research:
- Music therapy as evidence-based intervention (AMTA, 2020)
- Trauma recovery through music (Bensimon, Amir & Wolf, 2012)
- Neurological benefits of music (Koelsch, 2014; Levitin, 2006)
- Defining Music Therapy frameworks (Bruscia, 2014)

## Key Differentiators

- Live piano performance (not recorded music) enables real-time therapeutic adaptation
- Bilingual services (Spanish and English)
- Cultural sensitivity for displaced and transitioning populations
- No immigration status data collected; strict confidentiality
- Privacy-friendly analytics (GoatCounter, no cookies, GDPR/CCPA compliant)
